target_mpx.label: Render area (MPx)
target_mpx.help: Target area, rounded to multiples of 32. Higher values increase render cost and VRAM; GPU acceptance pending.

first_steps.label: First-pass steps
first_steps.help: First sampling schedule. More steps increase render time; GPU acceptance pending.

second_steps.label: Second-pass steps (conditional)
second_steps.help: Used only when the second pass is active. The canonical baseline leaves it disabled; this setting preserves that state.
